title: FedEx Corporation 8-K - Departure of CFO and Appointment of Interim CFO
summary: FedEx Corporation filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing that Executive Vice President and CFO John W. Dietrich will step down on June 1, 2026 and depart the company on July 31, 2026. The departure is not the result of any disagreement with the company. The board appointed Claude F. Russ, currently Enterprise Vice President Finance, to serve as Interim CFO effective June 1, 2026.
key_points: John W. Dietrich will step down as Executive Vice President and CFO on June 1, 2026 and depart the company on July 31, 2026
Dietrich's departure is not the result of any disagreement regarding financial controls, statements, operations, policies, or practices
Claude F. Russ appointed Interim CFO effective June 1, 2026; he will retain his current role as Enterprise Vice President Finance
Russ will receive $25,000 per month cash payment during tenure as Interim CFO plus $50,000 in restricted stock units vesting ratably over three years
FedEx will conduct a comprehensive internal and external search for a permanent CFO successor
The filing states FedEx will file an amendment within four business days after separation agreement terms are determined
